verdict.rationale: OpenClaw ships its own Docker install guide with Docker-based setup and onboarding, and its install docs list multiple official paths: desktop apps, installer script, npm/pnpm/bun, from source, Docker. It also documents remote access to a self-hosted Gateway via SSH tunnels and tailnets, which touches the VPS scenario. Only one of the story's four named targets (Docker) has a dedicated guide in evidence. Missing for 10: explicit Docker Compose guide, Kubernetes/Helm deployment guide, dedicated small-VPS deployment guide, Raspberry Pi guide, evidence the guides are maintained, independent hands-on corroboration.
